__note: Repository-shaped paths used by test/test-changed.test.mjs, kept out of the test source on purpose: a literal path in a test file is a dependency claim to the router, so naming real paths (docs/, public/, server.ts) would route the router's own 4s test suite on unrelated changes to those files.
